tools.name: find_writing_help
tools.description: Find the relevant Dearovo writing experience for a message you want to send. Does not access personal accounts or store relationship information.

tools.name: message_writing_tips
tools.description: Get privacy-conscious guidance for writing a caring message without inventing facts, commitments or relationship history.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: message_writing_tips · Public sink: find_writing_help.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: message_writing_tips · Public sink: find_writing_help

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
